choices.text: Recommend replacing the part and explain the safety reasons.
Do a careful weld repair with a reinforcing plate and inspect it.
Lay out both options with costs and let the farmer decide.

response.text: A farmer from Hanford brings you a disc harrow with a cracked frame member. A weld repair is cheaper and can be done today; a new part is safer but takes a week to arrive, right in the middle of field prep. As with the brake job you fixed yourself, you need to weigh the risks.
response.title: Weld it or replace it
